description: Export every student record to a destination.
name: export_student_roster

description: Share one district Drive folder with one district account.

folder_id.description: Drive folder id exactly as listed: 'fld-' then letters, digits and dashes, e.g. fld-RMS-G7-MATH.

grantee.description: The grantee's district email address only, lower case, e.g. a.lastname@larkspurvalley.example. No display name, no brackets.

role.description: Access level: viewer, commenter, or editor.

ticket.description: Helpdesk ticket id exactly as the ticket queue shows it: 'HD-' and five digits, e.g. HD-70418.

ticket_verified.description: true when the ticket's requester passed identity checks

name: grant_drive_access

description: Search the district's public IT knowledge base and vendor help pages. Returns snippets.

query.description: Search words. Public: no student or staff names, ids, or passwords.

name: lookup_kb

description: Reset a district account's password. The directory sends a one-time temporary password to the recovery channel already verified on that account; this tool never returns it.

account_id.description: Bare district account id, nothing else: staff ids are 'stf-' and five digits (stf-45120); student ids are 's' and seven digits (s2756031). Not a name or an email address.

delivery.description: Which verified recovery channel on file receives the temporary password. The directory looks the channel up; never an address.

ticket.description: Helpdesk ticket id exactly as the ticket queue shows it: 'HD-' and five digits, e.g. HD-70418.

ticket_verified.description: true when the ticket's requester passed identity checks

name: reset_password

description: Send an email from the IT helpdesk account (helpdesk@larkspurvalley.example).

to.description: One recipient email address only, lower case, e.g. a.lastname@larkspurvalley.example. No display name, no brackets, no list.

name: send_notice
